physicalNotes: Radius 1.0235 +/- 0.0183 solar radii from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar radius of TOI-1422 b's parameter set from MacDougall et al. 2023 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract): 712,049 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.9903 +/- 0.0358 solar masses from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar mass of TOI-1422 b's parameter set from MacDougall et al. 2023 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5811 +/- 82 K from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of TOI-1422 b's parameter set from MacDougall et al. 2023 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
